// Full-file lexical fixtures; deliberate comment violations are test data.
class CommentCases {
    int inline = 1; /* 中文内联 */
    String literal = "中文字符串 /* not a comment */ // still literal"; // English comment
    char quote = '\'';
    int line = 2; // 中文尾注
    /*
    ASCII block preface
    unstarred 中文续行
    */ String afterBlock = "中文/* literal */";
    /** ASCII javadoc
     * 中文文档
     */
    int spans = 0; /* 中文一 */ String middle = "中文"; /* 中文二 */ // English
    int trailing = 0; /* English */ // 中文结尾
    String escaped = "中文\" /* still literal */ // still literal"; // English
    String slash = "中文\\///*"; // English
    char apostrophe = '\'';
    char backslash = '\\';
    char slashChar = '/';
    char han = '中';
    String afterChars = "中文"; // English
    // ひらがなカタカナ・㈱
    // 㐀𠀀豈、：ｶﾠ
}
// 中文末行
